note: Held-out route test set written by Claude (an Anthropic model, acting as an isolated sub-agent) on 2026-09-21 from a written policy brief only; the author had seen neither the classifier's code nor any other test set or fixture in the repository. Labelling policy: each spoken task goal gets the cheapest route that fully and safely does it - a bare launch of one installed app or an explicit web search with a concrete query is a reflex (plus the planner when more is asked), while anything consequential, content-creating, following the launch of a writing or communication app, or asking to be told something without a web search is planner-only. Everything else goes to the lane, and genuinely ambiguous goals take the safer route (planner-only beats lane beats reflex), as stated in the case's why.
